affiliation.zh: 北京大学 · 博士研究生

school.en: School of Intelligence Science and Technology

intro.en: I explore how visualization can help us read historical evidence, understand complex relationships, and ask better questions.
intro.zh: 我关注如何通过可视化阅读历史证据、理解复杂关系，并提出更好的问题。

bio.en: I am a Ph.D. student at Peking University, advised by Xiaoru Yuan. My work connects visualization and visual analytics with digital humanities, through interactive systems for exploring documents, cultural heritage, and spatiotemporal data.
bio.zh: 我是北京大学智能学院的博士研究生，导师为袁晓如研究员。我的研究围绕可视化与可视分析展开，结合数字人文中的实际问题，构建用于探索历史文献、文化遗产与时空数据的交互式系统。

text.en: Reading across sources, versions, and the traces left in cultural artifacts.
text.zh: 在不同史料、版本与文物留下的痕迹之间展开对读。

text.en: Exploring the relationships between people, places, and moments in time.
text.zh: 探索人物、地点与时间之间的联系，让复杂关系变得可读。

text.en: Building visual tools that support exploration, comparison, and human interpretation.
text.zh: 构建支持探索、比较与人工解释的可视化工具。
